verdict.rationale: The CRA is a national tax authority, not a hosted data service, so user-selectable storage region or data residency does not fit this kind of product. The 'non-resident' registration path in the evidence concerns the owner's tax residency, not where data is stored, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
